description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceNotificationListenerService class in an Android app, verifying behavior related to shared preferences handling, quiet hours, rate limiting, and notification burst limiting.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationListenerServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DeviceNotificationListenerService, verifying preferences handling, quiet hours, and rate limiting logic.

methods.name: recentPackages_migratesLegacyPreferenceKey
methods.description: Test that recentPackages correctly migrates from a legacy preferences key.

methods.name: recentPackages_cleansUpLegacyKeyWhenNewKeyAlreadyExists
methods.description: Test that legacy preference keys are cleaned up when the new key exists.

methods.name: recentPackages_trimsDedupesAndPreservesRecencyOrder
methods.description: Test that recentPackages deduplicates entries and maintains recency order.

methods.name: quietHoursAndRateLimitingUseWallClockTimeNotNotificationPostTime
methods.description: Verify that quiet hours and rate limiting functions rely on wall clock time rather than notification post time.

methods.name: burstLimiter_capsAnyForwardedNotificationEvent
methods.description: Ensure that NotificationBurstLimiter caps forwarded notification events according to limits.
